about: Joel was a prophet who called people back to God and promised that God would pour out His Spirit.

pages.title: Return to God
pages.text: Bugs called locusts ate all the crops. Joel said, "Come back to God with all your heart! He is kind and loving." God promised, "I will give back what was lost. I will pour out my Spirit on everyone, young and old."
pages.lesson: God gives back what was lost when we return to Him.
